data: Formula Microscope and a bigger grid
Inspect formula results, resize the window and drag ranges into formulas.

Inspect the steps behind a formula. Click ƒx to see intermediate results, follow references or jump to the cell contributing to an error. Formula Microscope.

Make room for a larger sheet. Drag the grip at the lower right, or use Expand Window and Restore Compact Window from the command palette.
